title: extra verdict — the extra-review axis verdicts (backlog standards/spec/quality)
description: Shared by backlog's three extra-axis reviewers (standards, spec and quality), whose outputs have an identical shape. Enforces the shape the gate + prompt contract demand; the gates only check decision, which the schema enforces here. _io is stamped by the server.

decision.description: approve: nothing worth a follow-up task. findings: at least one follow-up is warranted. needs_human_review: the branch cannot be judged safely (routes the whole run to the human rescue gate).

summary.description: One or two sentences stating the verdict and why.

message.description: What is wrong and what the follow-up work must change.

files.description: Repository-relative paths; may be empty but must be present.

suggestion.description: The concrete remediation, not a restatement of the problem.
